confounders: No navigation bar/tab containment changes safe-area proposals, toolbar visibility and board placement. This arm tests the aggregate navigation/ancestor-host boundary; it does not isolate navigation controller internals from geometry. Measure rather than fake a toolbar spacer.

Train selectedBoardCard creates a prior board host in the normal route; direct root avoids that lifecycle/history. A pass could implicate ancestor/previous-host lifetime rather than sibling rendering.

Root direct launch skips normalBody onOpenURL/session persistence subscriptions; they are unrelated to observed within-session material values but should be documented as bypassed debug route. Do not present this as production navigation rewrite.
Gate startup timing may differ because no deep link/navigation transition; retain readiness and initial board loading/countdown trace, do not delay/synchronize source state silently.
Missing required environment objects crashes rather than reproduces; same root audioCoach must be explicitly delivered. Access refusal or prep prompt is not a rendering failure.

If direct root also fails, production layout/session itself is sufficient without navigation, but no individual cause/fix follows. If it passes and matched normal fails, next smallest boundary is root with NavigationStack alone versus full normal ancestor route, not renderer replacement.
